description: Audit sshd_config, sshd -T or a live SSH server's offered algorithms against CIS/NIST SSH hardening guidance
notes: Requires Python 3 on PATH (python.org installer with .py file association, or `scoop install python`). Run: sshd-hardening-auditor --help. Changelog: https://git.canutethegreat.com/CanuteTheGreat/sshd-hardening-auditor/releases
